notes.title: RUDE RACERS IS FINALLY HERE! Prepare to smash, crash and step on the gas!
notes.notes:
Oh hi there! So you like to break stuff, drive recklessly and pick a fight just for fun? Excellent! We’ve got the perfect cocktail of insane action and high-speed thrills for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/793b852aad3e429da86edbe936cb216acebb1ef4.png[/img]

After months of development and  experimentation on the quest for perfection in creating a highly accessible and supremely fun combat-racer, we are pleased to finally announce that we are prepared to bring Rude Racers out of Early Access! 

[b]The world of 2D games will never be the same after experiencing the crunchy, power-packed action of Rude Racers. With 5 seasons and over a dozen types of unique events ranging from point-to-point sprints and death matches to hot pursuits and outrageously intense boss battles, there’s plenty of smashing action everywhere you look and hours of straight-up fun gameplay with zero gimmicks.[/b]

Select your favourite rider, pick up a crazy weapon and launch your bike into one of the splendidly detailed tracks and prepare to weave through the treacherous obstacle courses, dodge attacks from your psychotic rivals and slip through the traffic to claim victory! Earn cash to trick out your bike with turbo kits, armour and other wacky power-ups and win trophies to unlock new game modes and seasons!

[b]Master the fine art of maniacal street racing in the long and demanding Seasons campaign or fire up the Quickplay mode for a short and fiery gaming session to test yourself in gruelling, randomly generated events. [/b]

[b]With the monthly LiveWire events, the madness spills over into the real world as players from across the globe will compete in these exclusive races to set the top times on the leaderboard—winners of the event will win Steam gift cards![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/92050b30700bb1b4bb8e400f629845b9727e0a7f.png[/img]

[b]Rude Racers is available NOW on Steam for only $1.99 and offers support for multiple languages including English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese[/b] and we will be adding more localisations very soon.

Finally, we want to convey our sincere thanks to the community here on Steam and other social channels for their continued support! This is our first project for PC and without their involvement, taking on this project and delivering a high-quality product for the PC audience will simply not have been possible. Further, your support in the way of buying a copy of Rude Racers will mean a lot to us and will directly enable us to make bigger and better games in the future :)

Prepare to smash, crash and step on the gas in this crazy carnival of speed!

notes.title: Rude Racers now supports Spanish, Chinese, Russian and Portuguese!
notes.notes:
Rude Racers is all set to leave Early Access and as we complete the finishing touches in the transition, we recently dropped a huge update with support for multiple languages for the first time in the game!

Our aim at Famous Dogg has always been to bring innovative, fun, fast and no-nonsense action to as wide an audience as possible, regardless of whether they experience our products on mobile or a full-fledged rig and the addition of new localisations in Rude Racers is a major step in that direction. 

A lot of rework and effort has had to be put in to setting up our tools and resources to accommodate something that was not a part of the original plan for what was going to be a small casual game, but with some help from cooperative and hardworking freelancers and a lot of dabbling with all sorts of translation tools on the internet, we are happy to report that we finally have a result that we feel matches the quality of the game!

[b]The latest available versions for Rude Racers feature localisations for Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Portuguese[/b] and we hope that with the every-growing community, which has been the driving force behind the development of our humble first attempt to bring our work to PC, we will be able to bring support for more languages to Rude Racers in the coming time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/47535299421ad6abd226bc44844d56c7cc3a53c6.png[/img]

With the launch only about a week away, the price is going to go up to $ 1.99 so if you have enjoyed speeding, fighting, crashing and breaking stuff in Rude Racers, do the whole damn gaming community a favour and spread the word for our final few Early Access copies which are going for only $0.99!

notes.title: Please nominate Rude Racers for Steam Awards 2019
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370091/c54bc110ce172e57c30520f804ce69fb2efb1ce9.jpg[/img]

Hello Racers!!

Let us start by first thanking you all for all the support that each and every one of you has shown not just during the Early Access phase but all through the development of the game. Dozens of users spent hours playing each level and each season and came back to us with their detailed feedback which was absolutely central to our efforts in improving and optimising Rude Racers. So once again, a BIG thanks to you all for being super awesome!

Ever since the game was launched in late October this year, hundreds have played and enjoyed Rude Racers- bikes have been sent flying into concrete walls, thousands of barrels have exploded and the cops.. boy have they got their work cut out in dealing with you reckless street racers!

Our ambition with Rude Racers was to make a fun racing game that could keep the users engaged with a tremendous variety in the types of events while being the first proper racing game where melee combat was deeply ingrained into its basic concept and played a major part in how the users develop strategies and build their own unique style as they power through the races in the different season. 

[b]You've helped this far and now we call upon you to please consider nominating Rude Racers for the 2019 Steam Awards. Now we might not win and that's fine but we always have looked at our users as a part of the team-- you guys are in it just as much as ourselves so why not try and see where we can take Rude Racers :)

So go ahead, drop us a nomination and if we get big, you get big too! Turbo Tommy even got a suit on in anticipation (though he couldn't get the helmet off!)[/b]

[h1]About the category- "Best Game You Suck At":[/h1]
Anyone who has played Rude Racers would agree that the game has a way of really pushing you to the limit of your driving and combat skills. With dangerous obstacles, menacing cops and the intense, relentless competition of the races, our users have constantly told us how there are few other games that can top the satisfaction that one feels after beating a challenging event in Rude Racers! It's always had that "one more race" appeal to it and we have worked quite hard to keep that intensity and addiction at the centre of the overall experience. 

[b]It is for this reason that we have picked the nomination category as the "Best Game You Suck At" because despite the consistently high level of challenge and it's unrivalled intensity that will punish your slightest mistake, Rude Racers will always have you coming back for more edge-of-your-seat racing action!
